capabilities: Draw handwriting with pen pressure on desktop and Android tablets
Insert rectangles, ellipses, lines and arrows with snapping
Fill closed areas with solid, hatch, crosshatch, dot or stipple patterns
Select, move, copy and paste strokes and shapes across canvases
Store drawings as line-delimited JSON .pencanvas files
disambiguation: Not a diagram or flowchart canvas; it is a handwriting and drawing surface with pen, eraser, shapes and fill.
extras: Desktop and Android tablets; S Pen pressure supported but the S Pen side-button eraser is noted as unverified on real hardware. Fill uses WebGL by default with Canvas 2D fallback. A diagnostic command reports pointer-event support and stylus sampling/pressure range. Chinese README included; interface follows Obsidian language (Chinese or English).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in infinite canvas for freehand handwriting and drawing with pen pressure, shapes and fill.
summary: Infinite handwriting canvas plugin for Obsidian with pressure-sensitive pen, shapes, arrows and pattern fill, saving drawings as readable JSON .pencanvas files.
